in_sanskrit.name: ज्ञानेश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: God of Knowledge or God of Wisdom

in_marathi.name: Gyanesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gyanesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gyanesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'gyan', meaning knowledge or wisdom. This name is bestowed upon a child to signify the desire for knowledge and the pursuit of wisdom throughout their life. In Hindu mythology, Gyanesh is associated with the god of knowledge, Lord Ganesha.
